publication_status: Published provisional profile — checklist review remains separate

distribution.narrative: Original evidence concerns interception from timber shipped from Taiwan; establishment in Taiwan is not demonstrated.

host_note: Browne (1980:498) reported Quercus sp. from intercepted timber, not an in situ standing tree.
taxonomy_summary: Platypus lunatulus Browne, 1980. Original publication and subsequent nomenclatural qualifications are documented below.

taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lunatulus
taxonomic_history.note: Original account pp. 497–498; original name and description verified.

nomenclature_note: Browne (1980:497–498) described specimens intercepted in Japanese quarantine from Taiwan-exported Quercus wood. This is a timber association, not proof of a locally established Taiwanese population. Synonymy with Platypus tayabasi remains unresolved.

references.label: Browne (1980) IV
references.citation: Browne, F. G. (1980). Bark beetles and ambrosia beetles (Coleoptera, Scolytidae and Platypodidae) intercepted at Japanese ports, with descriptions of new species. IV. Kontyû, 48(4): 490–500.
